proposal.observation: detected_lines.png: the binarised outlier map is extremely sparse; apart from the regular bolt-hole dot grid, the circumferential joint traces visible in depth_map_viridis.png (white bands near y~1500-1620, ~2220-2310, ~2700-2800 and ~210-390 full-res) barely survive binarisation. Only one joint pair yields oblique lines (green ~y1470, red ~y1620) and only in the 3 left-most and 2 right-most of the 10 ring columns; the 5 central columns have no oblique lines at all. initial_prompt_points.png shows a single propagated prompt row at y~1540 for all 10 rings. The 10 magenta vertical ring boundaries are correct (ring_count_error=0), depth_nan_ratio=0.114 is low (no depth-hole problem) and sam_fill_rate=0.78 is healthy, but correspondence_f1@15=0.113, boundary_explained_edge@25=0.207 and chamfer_sym_px=94 show that the SAM block boundaries do not land on the true joint edges.
proposal.rule: d7 (m_line_yield low; prompt centres come from a single propagated row) -> f_missing_lines. Precondition for r_relax_hough checked: f_depth_holes ruled out (depth_nan_ratio 0.11, sam_fill_rate 0.78); f_joint_oversmoothed cannot be addressed inside bounds (depth_threshold_low/high not exposed, curvature_threshold direction on joints is unattributed), so act at stage 4. Inter-stage chain f_missing_lines -> f_pattern_mismatch -> stage_5 f_crop_offset explains the low correspondence despite good fill and ring count.
proposal.rationale: Stage 1 is locked, so unfolding is untouched. The weak feature is correspondence_f1@15; ring count and fill are already good, so the overlay must not disturb the vertical band (hough_threshold_vertical, uniform_k_snap unchanged) or SAM template geometry (segment_width, K_height, angle unchanged). Apply r_relax_hough conservatively: lower binary_threshold to 110 so faint joint pixels survive binarisation before dilation, lower hough_threshold_oblique to 30 (not to the ~20 floor used by degrade example g005, which also combined binary 150 and a loose vertical band and zeroed correspondence), and raise maxLineGap_oblique to 50 so the dotted joint traces link into 5-10 deg segments across more of the 10 columns. Spurious-line risk from the bolt-hole grid is limited because row/column alignments fall at ~0/90 deg and are rejected by the oblique angle filter. pattern_tolerance is raised modestly to 14 so additional intersections at the second joint row (~y2260) can be accepted by the K/AB distance pattern, giving per-ring prompt centres instead of one propagated row. Worked examples s000/s019 (binary 100-118, tolerance 14-16, maxLineGap 36-53) kept ring_count_error=0, supporting that these detecting changes do not break ring recovery; their proxy losses were joint with SAM/unfolding changes that are deliberately not repeated here.
